div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
provider already named —
stop re-litigating the choice

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
specifies the contract;
loop-test authors the files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
publishes an API;
loop-integrate consumes one

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
backward-looking memo feeds
the forward-looking gate

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bake complete —
the service is yours

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
loop-integrate
«component» platform integration
Obeys someone else's contract and defends against it:
OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, idempotency, retry

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
loop-ship
«component» release
Deploy start to bake complete: rollout strategy,
flags, expand-contract migrations, tested rollback
